verdict.rationale: Babylon.js core is an Apache-2.0 open-source engine published as npm packages (@babylonjs/core 9.26.1, about 234k weekly downloads). It ships as tree-shakable ES6 modules you can bundle and serve from your own infrastructure, and it can run server-side via NullEngine. That lets users fully self-host the core product. Missing for 10: no evidence that the hosted companion tools (Playground, Node Material Editor, Sandbox) can be self-hosted, and no explicit first-party self-hosting guide or independent corroboration.
